newsitem.title: CANADA: Saxon Petroleum may be put on block.
newsitem.headline: Saxon Petroleum may be put on block.

text.p: Saxon Petroleum Inc said on Monday it appointed a special committee of directors to assess the company's assets and seek ways to "maximize shareholder value."
Saxon, whose share price has slipped to 0.80 from 1.20 in late December, said in a statement that it intended to hire financial advisers to assist in the process.
Saxon had expected to spend C$40 million in 1997 in efforts to increase oil and gas production to 5,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day before the end of the year.
Other recent developments included the June resignation of three directors and a move in May by Denver-based Forest Oil Corp to increase its ownership in Saxon to about 65 percent.
Saxon officials were not immediately available for comment.
